scope: Compiled mapping observer with modeled NT file IO, page tables, CPUID, MSRs and PnP callbacks
tests: Seeded bounded write-through trace captures AddDevice and optional PnP status without altering it
Trace mode forwards START after recording resource-list counts
Wrong marker, wrong size, missing file and write failures stop explicitly; no successful writes
Elevated IRQL skips file IO; unload records and closes owned handle
Used trace accepted; record count restarts for this boot and stale tail is cleared
Mapping observer reads present/nonpresent PTEs, skips PAE, gates/bounds MSRs, and never changes cache registers/page tables
Successful mapping keeps original aperture/flags/ABI and appends observation records
